metadata.description: Council: a swarm with seats. Multi-persona deliberation with an evidence ledger, for any subject in any field.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: A council of AI personas, chaired by a neutral chair, that assesses a company, idea, deal, decision, initiative or research question for the person who convenes it. Benches per hat, presets to start from, seats you add or remove in a minute, rounds that pick up where the last one ended, and an evidence ledger behind every claim.
